title: Uruk & Najaf Shrine
full_text:
The Ancient City of Uruk & Najaf After breakfast, we begin our journey North towards Samawa to visit the Ancient City of Uruk (approx. 2.5 - 3 hours), a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Uruk is historically significant as one of the world's first cities and the place where writing originated around 3300 BC.
You will explore the archaeological remains that provided the earliest evidence of pottery and cuneiform tablets.
Uruk is also famously known as the home of the legendary King Gilgamesh, the hero of the oldest epic in human history.
Following our visit to Uruk, we will drive to Najaf and check into the hotel.
In the evening, we will take a walking tour to the area of the Shrine of Imam Ali, one of the most significant architectural and spiritual landmarks in the region.
You will also have the opportunity to explore the Grand Bazaar of Najaf, famous for its vibrant atmosphere, jewelry, and traditional goods.
